dependence: draws are half-splits of the same realized series: dependent, so B raises resolution, not independence

sliding.construction: fixed-length adjacent sliding: AUC(full[s:s+L], full[s+L:s+2L]) for every start s (stride 1) of the full real series (train + valid + test), exhaustive
sliding.population_limitation: the population spans about 20 years while the observed comparison is the test period; positions overlap almost completely, so enumeration is not independence (about N / 2L independent block pairs)
